# Overhaul
Overhaul adds 2 new items a cleaver and a greatsword, the cleaver is fast and high damage, while the greatsword is higher damage but slow, but eventho the greatsword might seem like the worse option it has the special ability to block damage with a 35% passthrough off damage, even being able to block fall damage

## War Trident
thats right, overhaul adds a new trident too the game, an upgrade from the old one, fresh enchants. you can enchant it like a sword or with normal trident enchants, and on it riptide works outside water:O with two custom enchants, one called Drag that basically pushs the player or entity you're attacking away, and 2 pinning, pins the entity or player youre fighting into the ground not allowing them too move, also disables ender pearls aswell

## Enchantments: 
Butcher's Tax
Each hit siphons a portion of the damage dealt back as healing.The amount absorbed : 20%

Carcass Splitter
Deals bonus damage to enemies that are already suffering from negative status effects. Each active debuff on the target increases damage by 4%, up to a maximum of 20% bonus damage. Pairs well with poison, slowness, or any debuff-heavy playstyle.

Sunder Armor 
Successive hits stack a Sunder debuff on your target, reducing their effective armor with each application. Stacks up to 3 times. Level I reduces armor by 3% per stack, Level II by 4%, Level III by 5% — up to 15% armor strip at max level and stacks.


Soul Cleave 
A powerful enchantment exclusive to the Greatsword. When a soul charge is consumed, the attack deals 40% bonus damage. Cannot be found in the enchanting table — obtained only through treasure.


P.S to get the Copper scrap, just mine copper, it works
